policy: Exact station/EVSE tariffs only; official CPO sources preferred; no extrapolation from roaming, subscription, historical or sampled tariffs.

cpos.classificationReason: The current official WEMAG charging-card page explicitly publishes prices for ad-hoc charging at public WEMAG stations and states that they apply exclusively at WEMAG-branded stations. AC and DC prices plus start/blocking-fee semantics are all numeric and network-scoped.

verifiedDirectEvidence.effectiveStatement: page currently states these prices apply from 2023-01-01

guardrails: Do not apply WEMAG roaming/app partner prices to WEMAG CPO stations unless the station is confirmed WEMAG-operated.
No eMI3 prefix inferred without authoritative mapping.

cpos.classificationReason: The current official SWE Strom.laden consumer page publishes a dedicated 'ohne Vertrag' matrix valid from 2026-03-01, including AC/DC energy prices and the blocking-fee rule. The QR/Ladenetz app flow is documented on the same page.
guardrails: Business net prices are not mixed into the consumer tariff.
Roaming prices for other operators are not applied to SWE-operated EVSEs.
No eMI3 prefix inferred without authoritative mapping.

cpos.classificationReason: The official SWS public-charging page identifies the operator's public site at Eckdrift 43-45 with four 49/50 kW DC points and publishes direct m8mit pricing. A current BNetzA-derived operator inventory independently shows exactly two charging devices / four charge points for SWS, matching the official site's four public points; therefore no uncovered SWS public EVSE scope remains in the current register snapshot.

verifiedDirectEvidence.scopeCrossCheck: BNetzA-derived inventory dated 2026-07-28 reports 2 charging devices / 4 charge points for Stadtwerke Schwerin GmbH (SWS).

guardrails: The third-party page is used only as a BNetzA-derived scope cross-check, not as tariff authority.
RFID/app roaming prices remain provider-specific and are not substituted for m8mit direct pricing.

notes: WEMAG official page gives complete network-scoped ad-hoc AC/DC price and explicitly zero start/blocking fees.
Erfurt uses the official consumer 'ohne Vertrag' matrix rather than business net or roaming prices.
Schwerin price authority is official SWS; BNetzA-derived inventory is used only to confirm the four-point CPO scope.
No unverified eMI3 prefix was invented for WEMAG or SWE Energie.
